title: IDS for subordinate Brownian motions in Poisson random environment on nested fractals
summary: We establish the Lifshitz singularity of the integrated density of states (IDS) for random Schrödinger operators \[ H^ω = φ(-\mathcal{L}) + V^ω \] on planar unbounded nested fractals with the Good Labeling Property. Here, $\mathcal{L}$ is the Laplacian on the fractal, $φ$ is an operator monotone function with mild regularity, and $V^ω$ is a Poissonian random potential with a sufficiently regular profile. The main novelty of our work lies in showing that the study of $V^ω$ can be effectively reduced to the analysis of certain alloy-type potential, where the sites are no longer lattice points…
